messages.news-and-changes.96: Added support for notes in 'netwatch-notify', these are included verbatim into the notification.
messages.news-and-changes.97: Modified 'dhcp-to-dns' to always add A records for names with mac address, and optionally add CNAME records if the host name is available.
messages.news-and-changes.98: Extended 'check-certificates' to download new certificate by SubjectAltNames if download by CommonName fails.
messages.news-and-changes.99: Modified 'dhcp-to-dns', which dropped global configuration. Settings moved to dhcp server's network definitions.
messages.news-and-changes.100: The script 'ssh-keys-import' became a module 'mod/ssh-keys-import' with enhanced functionality.
messages.news-and-changes.101: Introduced new script 'fw-addr-lists' to download, import and update firewall address-lists.
messages.news-and-changes.103: Dropped hard-coded name and timeout from 'hotspot-to-wpa-cleanup', instead a comment is required for dhcp server now.
messages.news-and-changes.104: All relevant scripts were ported to new wifiwave2 and are available for AX devices now!
messages.news-and-changes.105: Extended 'check-routeros-update' to support automatic update from specific neighbor(s).
messages.news-and-changes.106: Modified 'telegram-chat' to make it act on message replies, without activation. Also made it answer a single question mark with a short notice.
messages.news-and-changes.107: Dropped support for non-fixed width font in Telegram notifications.
messages.news-and-changes.108: Enhanced 'log-forward' to list log messages with colorful bullets to indicate severity.
messages.news-and-changes.109: Added support to send notifications via Ntfy (ntfy.sh).
messages.news-and-changes.110: Dropped support for loading scripts from local storage.
messages.news-and-changes.111: Modified 'dhcp-to-dns' to allow multiple records for one mac address.
messages.news-and-changes.112: Enhanced 'mod/ssh-keys-import' to record the fingerprint of keys.
messages.news-and-changes.113: Added helper functions for easier setup to Matrix notification module.
messages.news-and-changes.114: All relevant scripts were ported to new wifi package for RouterOS 7.13 and later. Migration is complex and thus not done automatically!
messages.news-and-changes.117: Enhanced 'packages-update' to support deferred reboot on automatically installed updates.
messages.news-and-changes.119: Added support for IPv6 to script 'fw-addr-lists'.
messages.news-and-changes.120: Implemented a workaround in 'backup-cloud'. Now script should no longer just crash, but send notification with error.
messages.news-and-changes.121: The 'wifiwave2' scripts are finally gone. Development continues with 'wifi' in RouterOS 7.13 and later.
messages.news-and-changes.122: The global configuration was enhanced to support loading snippets. Configuration can be split off to scripts where name starts with 'global-config-overlay.d/'.
messages.news-and-changes.123: Introduced new function '$LogPrint', and deprecated '$LogPrintExit2'. Please update custom scripts if you use it.
messages.news-and-changes.124: Added support for links in 'netwatch-notify', these are added below the formatted notification text.
messages.news-and-changes.126: Made 'telegram-chat' capable of handling large command output. Telegram messages still limit the size, so it is truncated now.
messages.news-and-changes.127: Added support for authentication to Ntfy notification module.
messages.news-and-changes.128: Added another list from blocklist.de to default configuration for 'fw-addr-lists'.
messages.news-and-changes.129: Extended 'backup-partition' to support RouterOS copy-over - interactively or before feature update.
messages.news-and-changes.130: Dropped intermediate certificates, depending on just root certificates now.
messages.news-and-changes.131: Enhanced certificate download to fallback to mkcert.org, so all (commonly trusted) root certificates are available now.
messages.news-and-changes.132: Split off plugins from 'check-health', so the script works on all devices to monitor CPU and RAM. The supported plugins for sensors in hardware are installed automatically.
messages.news-and-changes.133: Updated the default configuration for 'fw-addr-lists', deprecated lists were removed, a collective list was added.
messages.news-and-changes.134: Enhanced 'mod/notification-telegram' and 'telegram-chat' to support topics in groups.
messages.news-and-changes.135: Introduced helper function '$GetTelegramChatId' for 'mod/notification-telegram' which helps retrieve information.
messages.news-and-changes.136: Introduced script 'check-perpetual-license' to check for license state on CHR.
messages.news-and-changes.137: Added support to send notifications via Gotify (gotify.net).
messages.news-and-changes.138: RouterOS 7.19 is suffering an issue with certificate store. Fixing trust state for all certificates...
messages.news-and-changes.139: Certificate Authorities will reduce the leaf certificate validity times soon. Thus the defaults for renewal and warning in 'check-certificates' were decreased.
messages.news-and-changes.140: The scripts 'lease-script' was renamed to 'dhcpv4-server-lease', configuration was updated automatically.
messages.news-and-changes.141: Introduced script 'dhcpv6-client-lease' to run several scripts on IPv6 DHCP client lease.
messages.news-and-changes.142: Added a setting for 'mod/notification-email' to check availability of certificate chain.
messages.news-and-changes.143: Made backup scripts 'backup-email' and 'backup-upload' support date & time in filenames.
messages.news-and-changes.144: Split and reworked 'mode-button' for compatibility with RouterOS 7.24, configuration was updated automatically.
messages.news-and-changes.145: Split and reworked 'hotspot-to-wpa' for compatibility with RouterOS 7.24, configuration was updated automatically.
messages.news-and-changes.115: Celebrating {before}1.000 stars {after}on Github! Please continue starring...
messages.news-and-changes.116: ... and also please keep in mind that it takes a huge amount of time maintaining these scripts. {thanks}
messages.news-and-changes.118: RouterOS packages increase in size with each release. This becomes a problem for devices with 16MB storage and below. {device}Huge configuration and lots of scripts give an extra risk. Take care!
messages.news-and-changes.125: April's Fool! {party}Well, you missed it... - no charge nor fees. (Anyway... Donations are much appreciated, {smile}thanks!)
messages.news-and-changes.donation.request: Following the donation hint {arrow}to keep me motivated is much appreciated. Thanks!
messages.news-and-changes.donation.thanks: Looks like you did donate already. {heart}Much appreciated, thanks!
messages.news-and-changes.146: Added multilingual notifications and diagnostics. Set ScriptLanguage in global-config-overlay to select a language; English remains available offline. Shared helpers now require global-functions.d/core-extra, installed automatically on update.
